sentences.text: This is a petition filed under section 528 of BNSS, 2023 seeking quashing of the FIR No. 109/2021 dated 14.02.2021 under section 498A/406/34 of IPC registered at PS Tilak Nagar.

sentences.text: The petitioner is present in Court and is identified by Mr. Rajat Tanwar, leaned counsel.
Respondent No. 2 is also present in Court and is identified by Mr. Lalit Maini, learned counsel and SI Jatin, PS Tilak Nagar.

6. Since the parties have arrived at a settlement and no disputes are pending, I am convinced that quashing of such proceedings on account of compromise would bring peace and would secure ends of justice.
The Court does not see any fruitful purpose if criminal proceedings are permitted to be prosecuted any further.
7. In this view of the matter, there is no reason to continue the proceedings.
Hence, the aforesaid FIRs and the consequential proceedings arising therefrom are quashed.
8. With these directions, the petition is disposed of.
JASMEET SINGH, J NOVEMBER 12, 2024 /
